title: Automatic Hamburger Machine - 50 Years Ahead of Its Time!
summary: A circa-1964 film showing AMF's AMFare system, which ordered, cooked and packaged hamburgers, fries, shakes and more automatically for a pilot fast-food operation.
why: HN cites it as historical precedent in threads about restaurant robots and automation, noting it worked but was not cost-effective.

quote.text: The first was AMFare, built in 1964 by American Machine and Foundry, and it was better than most of its successors.
